instructions: Request a program be added to the tracker by adding an entry to "queue" below: { "link": "https://...", "note": "optional context", "submitted_by": "optional name/handle", "submitted_date": "YYYY-MM-DD" }. Open a pull request with your addition. The periodic update agent researches each pending entry and either adds it to data/tracker.json (as a funded Economics Master's or PhD program) and removes it from this queue, or — if it doesn't qualify (not funded, not Economics, page unreachable, already tracked, etc.) — leaves the entry here with "status": "needs-review" and an "agent_note" explaining why, for a human to resolve.
